title: MOND (Modified Newtonian Dynamics, Milgrom 1983)
efc_relevance: Interpolation function μ(x) with characteristic scale a0 ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹⁰ m/s² fits SPARC rotation curves without dark matter. EFC contains MOND as the low-acceleration local limit: EFC's Grid-AQUAL construction reduces to Milgrom's force law when a ≪ a0 and S-gradient saturates. Shared phenomenology at galactic scales, different ontology, different predictions at cluster scale (where MOND underpredicts, EFC predicts dense-regime return to Newtonian).
ledger_action: Logged as galactic-scale mechanistic relative. Cross-reference SPARC tests (ledger_galaxy_rotation_curves_sparc) and Verlinde 2016 (shared a0).
